tickets.description:
Add, edit and delete Info services in the TSP itinerary and the Add Service flow. Manual path only; template-sourced Info is TB-602 and out of scope. Merged in PRs TravelEdge/TripArc.TripBuilder#740 and #764. ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA TSP itinerary: 1. Each day card has an 'Add Service' button that opens the add flow for that day. 2. An Info row shows an 'Info only' badge and no price, no status and no Recheck control. Non-Info rows on the same day do show price/status/Recheck. 3. Modify opens the Info edit form. Delete works as for other services. 4. After an add, edit or delete the itinerary updates without a reload. A new or edited Info appears in start-time order. TSP detail sheet: 5. An Info sheet shows the Details and Travellers tabs only - no Booking tab and no T&Cs tab. (A Hotel sheet shows Details, Booking, Travellers and T&Cs.) 6. The sheet renders the sanitised HTML description, plus start and end time when set. An Info with no times shows the date alone. 7. After an edit is saved, an already-open sheet shows the new values. TSP travellers: 8. An Info can be assigned travellers like an Activity. 9. The Travellers tab follows an add or delete without a reload, and traveller labels follow a rename. Shopping, Add Service flow: 10. 'info' is a ShoppingType with a picker tile. The picker shows Hotel, Flight, Activity, Ground transfer, Cruise and Info. 11. The Info tile shows only for hosts that render Info (TSP), from a day card, or from the toolbar flow once a day has been picked. 12. The form has Title, a disabled Date pre-filled from the day, optional Start and End time, and an optional rich-text description supporting bold, italic and underline. 13. Submit is gated on the title alone: the submit button is disabled while Title is empty and enabled as soon as a title is typed, before any description or time is entered. On the edit form, clearing the title re-disables Save. OBSERVED VALUES FROM MANUAL QA (use these as concrete expectations) - Info sheet tabs read exactly: 'Details', 'Travellers'. - Description persisted and rendered as:

Sunset drinks at the rooftop bar. Smart casual dress code.

- A sheet with times reads: 'Date Dec 3, 2026 - Start 6:30 PM - End 8:00 PM'. - The disabled date input carries value='2026-12-03'. - Add calls POST /bff/api/shopping-orchestration/draft-trips/{tripId}/days/{day}/add-info-service and returns 202. - Edit calls PUT /bff/api/shopping-orchestration/draft-trips/{tripId}/services/{serviceId}/replace-info and returns 202. - Trip price and commission are unchanged across a full add -> edit -> delete cycle. KNOWN OPEN DEFECTS - do not write tests asserting this behaviour is correct: - No start/end time validation: startTime 23:45 with endTime 23:15 is accepted and rendered. - A very long description is not truncated anywhere in the UI. AREAS TOUCHED apps/tsp - Info detail sheet, day-card 'Add Service' button, Info row rendering. apps/shopping - 'info' in ShoppingType and picker tiles; Info form rendered by the shell; ShoppingFlowStore 'opened from a day' signal. apps/trip - FE ServiceType union gains 'Info'.
